dispositions.topic_text: Filesystem modification-time observation, read count, and snapshot consistency
dispositions.what: The modification time comes from one metadata reading of the listed path, taken before its bytes are read.

dispositions.topic_text: Required pre-state, outcome, and persistence assertions for the INV-06 recovery test
dispositions.what: The witness of the INV-06 recovery states its failed-call state, the placed status of the retry and the stored image and record it leaves.
